title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-20 02:06:42 最新章节：第2834章 飞舟之上
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
大宋西京天牢！
“又到送饭时间了！”
一身狱卒打扮的林铭左右手各拎着一个木桶，从后厨向着牢房走去！
他原本是天朝之人，擦拭祖传玉佩之时，穿越到了这里，脑海之中，已经多了另外一人的记忆！
在多出来的记忆之中，他是大宋天牢里面的一名送饭狱卒！
这个行当，并不是祖传的。
十年之前，京都之乱后，初期没人愿意成为天牢狱卒，才让他捡了个便宜，成为了天牢狱卒！
至于他的家人，母亲在他出生不久后，就因病去世，父亲也在京都之乱中，死于北莽乱军之手。
家中就只剩他一人而已！
他的目光也掠过了脑海之中他穿越的源泉！
那就是在他的脑海之中，唯有他自己才能够“看见”的一方玉佩！
时空玉佩！
效果只有一个，可以让他拥有无尽寿元！
除此之外，没有其他效果，他依然会生病，会死！
天牢的牢房，分为甲乙丙丁四号牢房，设计之初，是按照罪犯的罪过程度来进行区分的，甲字号关押死刑犯，乙字号关押待审的死刑犯，丙字号则是重刑犯，丁字号则是一些轻刑犯！
国朝两百年多年江山，规矩早就被破坏得差不多了！
尤其十年前又经历了京都之乱，太祖定下的规矩，算是彻底被消灭的一个干净！
所谓京都之乱，是十年前，北莽骑兵攻破大宋京都，将宋武帝和满朝文武掠走，当时还是太子的当今圣上在西京称帝，称为宋文帝，号召天下兵马勤王救驾！
十八路兵马勤王！
在十八路兵马的攻打之下，北莽且战且退，最终占据了大宋北方三州六府！

西京，也成为了大宋新的京都！
如今甲乙丙丁四号牢房关押之人，就看一个标准，是不是有权有钱！
丙字号和丁字号关押的是无权无势之人，乙字号关押的是有钱之人，甲字号关押的才是有权有势之人！
“开饭了！”
“开饭了！”
林铭送饭，从来都是从丁字号开始送起！
“大人，多给一些吧！”
“大人，再给一勺吧！”
牢犯们听到林铭的动静，一个个探出头来，用祈求的态度和林铭说着。
林铭大部分理都不理，唯有少数已然快要饿死的，他才会稍微多给对方一些饭食！
天牢的饭食分成两部分！
一部分就是他现在给打的木桶里面的饭食，这是大锅饭，一桶里面仅仅放了两勺陈米，清汤寡水，味道还如同猪食一般！
主要供给丙字号和丁字号的犯人！
还有一种，就是小食堂所做的饭食，专门供给甲字号和乙字号的犯人！
小食堂的饭菜，也不是什么人都能吃得起的……
明码标价！
光是一天两顿白米饭，就要十两银子！
这还是包月的价格，要是散吃，一天两顿，十五两银子，概不讲价！
这些犯人进来之后，住的位置，也就等同于他们的权势如何了？！
content_en:
Xijing Tianlao in the Great Song Dynasty!
"It's time to deliver food again!"
Lin Ming, who was dressed as a jailer, was carrying a wooden bucket in each hand and walked from the kitchen to the cell!
He was originally from the Celestial Dynasty, but when he was wiping his ancestral jade pendant, he traveled here and had the memory of another person in his mind!
In the extra memory, he was a food delivery jailer in the Song Dynasty Prison!
This trade is not inherited from ancestors.
Ten years ago, after the Kyoto Rebellion, no one wanted to be a jailer in the sky, so he took advantage and became a jailer in the sky!
As for his family, his mother died of illness not long after he was born, and his father also died at the hands of Beimang rebels during the Kyoto Rebellion.
He is the only one left in the family!
His eyes also glanced at the source of his journey in his mind!
That was the jade pendant in his mind that only he could "see"!
Time and space jade pendant!
There is only one effect, it can give him endless longevity!
Apart from this, there is no other effect, he will still get sick and die!
The cells in Tianlao are divided into cells A, B, C, and D. When originally designed, they were divided according to the degree of the criminal's crime. Cells A housed death row inmates, cell B held death row inmates awaiting trial, cells C housed serious criminals, and cell D held light criminals!
The country has been in the country for more than two hundred years, and the rules have been broken for a long time!
Especially after the Kyoto Rebellion ten years ago, the rules set by Taizu were completely wiped out!
The so-called chaos in Kyoto happened ten years ago when the Beimang cavalry broke into the Kyoto of the Song Dynasty and robbed Emperor Wu of the Song Dynasty and the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty. The current emperor, who was still the prince at the time, proclaimed himself emperor in Xijing and was called Emperor Wen of the Song Dynasty. He called on the soldiers and horses of the world to rescue him!
The King of the Eighteenth Route Army!
Under the attack of eighteen soldiers and horses, Beimang fought and retreated, and finally occupied the three states and six prefectures in the northern Song Dynasty!
Xijing also became the new Kyoto of the Song Dynasty!
Nowadays, the people detained in cells No. 4 of A, B, C and D are judged by one criterion: whether they have power and money!
Cells C and D imprison the powerless, cell B imprisons the rich, and cell A imprisons the powerful!
"It's time to eat!"
"It's time to eat!"
When Lin Ming delivers meals, he always starts with the letter "T"!
"Sir, give me more!"
"Sir, give me another spoonful!"
When the prisoners heard Lin Ming's movements, they poked their heads out one by one and spoke to Lin Ming in a praying manner.
Lin Ming ignored most of them. Only a few of them were about to starve to death, so he would give them a little more food!
The meal in Tianlao is divided into two parts!
Part of it is the food in the wooden barrel that he is filling now. This is a big pot of rice. There are only two spoons of old rice in the barrel. The clear soup is not watery, and it tastes like pig food!
Mainly supplies prisoners with sizes C and T!
There is another kind, which is the meals cooked in the small canteen, which are specially provided for prisoners in the A and B sizes!
Not everyone can afford the food in the canteen...
Clearly marked price!
Just two meals of white rice a day costs ten taels of silver!
This is still the price of a monthly subscription. If you eat in bulk, it costs fifteen taels of silver for two meals a day. No bargaining!
After these prisoners come in, where they live is equivalent to their power? !
